meta.title: Martial Artists
meta.description: With a wicked yet cunning formula at hand, they delve into the garden in search of excitement.

units.rawText: Gate 6 of the event grounds, still under construction.
units.displayText: Gate 6 of the event grounds, still under construction.

spans.text: Gate 6 of the event grounds, still under construction.

units.rawText: Wow, this place is big. I guessed before about what they were up to in here, but I never imagined something on this scale.
units.displayText: Wow, this place is big. I guessed before about what they were up to in here, but I never imagined something on this scale.

spans.text: Wow, this place is big. I guessed before about what they were up to in here, but I never imagined something on this scale.

units.rawText: Looks like this New Year is going to be one to look forward to! Right, Aki?
units.displayText: Looks like this New Year is going to be one to look forward to! Right, Aki?

spans.text: Looks like this New Year is going to be one to look forward to! Right, Aki?

units.rawText: Oi, Aki! What are you standing around for?
units.displayText: Oi, Aki! What are you standing around for?

spans.text: Oi, Aki! What are you standing around for?

units.rawText: Aki stops his survey of the surroundings, knocking on a switch by the door with his knuckles.
units.displayText: Aki stops his survey of the surroundings, knocking on a switch by the door with his knuckles.

spans.text: Aki stops his survey of the surroundings, knocking on a switch by the door with his knuckles.

units.rawText: Is it really okay for us to enter like this? Something just feels off.
units.displayText: Is it really okay for us to enter like this? Something just feels off.

spans.text: Is it really okay for us to enter like this? Something just feels off.

units.rawText: We didn't see a single agent on the way here, and this door doesn't...
units.displayText: We didn't see a single agent on the way here, and this door doesn't...

spans.text: We didn't see a single agent on the way here, and this door doesn't...

units.rawText: This gate doesn't seem like it's supposed to be open to us. It looks more like it was destroyed by someone.
units.displayText: This gate doesn't seem like it's supposed to be open to us. It looks more like it was destroyed by someone.

spans.text: This gate doesn't seem like it's supposed to be open to us. It looks more like it was destroyed by someone.

units.rawText: Is that so? Let me see... huh, doesn't seem to be functioning...
units.displayText: Is that so? Let me see... huh, doesn't seem to be functioning...

spans.text: Is that so? Let me see... huh, doesn't seem to be functioning...

units.rawText: Maybe it just hasn't started yet? Relax, the post was from an official organizer.
units.displayText: Maybe it just hasn't started yet? Relax, the post was from an official organizer.

spans.text: Maybe it just hasn't started yet? Relax, the post was from an official organizer.

units.rawText: Come what may, we'll deal with it. Adapting to happenstance is a part of the path we walk!
units.displayText: Come what may, we'll deal with it. Adapting to happenstance is a part of the path we walk!

spans.text: Come what may, we'll deal with it. Adapting to happenstance is a part of the path we walk!

units.rawText: I suppose you're right... we'll have to find staff to find out what's going on then.
units.displayText: I suppose you're right... we'll have to find staff to find out what's going on then.

spans.text: I suppose you're right... we'll have to find staff to find out what's going on then.

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah, let's go already; I can't wait!
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah, let's go already; I can't wait!

spans.text: Yeah, yeah, let's go already; I can't wait!

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: As the two crossed the boundary, a wispy metallic ringing filled the air.
units.displayText: As the two crossed the boundary, a wispy metallic ringing filled the air.

spans.text: As the two crossed the boundary, a wispy metallic ringing filled the air.

units.rawText: Do you feel it, too?
units.displayText: Do you feel it, too?

spans.text: Do you feel it, too?

units.rawText: Yes... this sound and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...
units.displayText: Yes... this sound and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...

spans.text: Yes... this sound and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...

units.rawText: Aki and Jiangyu gaze at each other, subconsciously entering defensive stances.
units.displayText: Aki and Jiangyu gaze at each other, subconsciously entering defensive stances.

spans.text: Aki and Jiangyu gaze at each other, subconsciously entering defensive stances.

units.rawText: That post never specified exactly what "participating" entails, but my intuition tells me that this is no simple task.
units.displayText: That post never specified exactly what "participating" entails, but my intuition tells me that this is no simple task.

spans.text: That post never specified exactly what "participating" entails, but my intuition tells me that this is no simple task.

units.rawText: Yeah. I've not been in the Oasis for long, so I can't say I know them very well... such a dangerous atmosphere. Don't tell me the special event is us fighting them?
units.displayText: Yeah. I've not been in the Oasis for long, so I can't say I know them very well... such a dangerous atmosphere. Don't tell me the special event is us fighting them?

spans.text: Yeah. I've not been in the Oasis for long, so I can't say I know them very well... such a dangerous atmosphere. Don't tell me the special event is us fighting them?

units.rawText: I've had but a few meetings with Sakuya myself. I had thought them the more straight-laced type, but this feeling... does fill me with anticipation.
units.displayText: I've had but a few meetings with Sakuya myself. I had thought them the more straight-laced type, but this feeling... does fill me with anticipation.

spans.text: I've had but a few meetings with Sakuya myself. I had thought them the more straight-laced type, but this feeling... does fill me with anticipation.

units.rawText: Hehe, I'm already getting pumped!
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm already getting pumped!

spans.text: Hehe, I'm already getting pumped!

units.rawText: Intriguing. Let's see if there are any staff nearby so we can figure out exactly what is going on.
units.displayText: Intriguing. Let's see if there are any staff nearby so we can figure out exactly what is going on.

spans.text: Intriguing. Let's see if there are any staff nearby so we can figure out exactly what is going on.

units.rawText: Jiangyu and Aki turn a corner in their search and are met with a crooked road sign, fashioned in a twisted manner.
units.displayText: Jiangyu and Aki turn a corner in their search and are met with a crooked road sign, fashioned in a twisted manner.

spans.text: Jiangyu and Aki turn a corner in their search and are met with a crooked road sign, fashioned in a twisted manner.

units.rawText: Does this mean turn right? It's all contorted and gnarly... the set pieces here truly are unique.
units.displayText: Does this mean turn right? It's all contorted and gnarly... the set pieces here truly are unique.

spans.text: Does this mean turn right? It's all contorted and gnarly... the set pieces here truly are unique.

units.rawText: Were these marks of battle damage created on purpose as well? Quite realistic.
units.displayText: Were these marks of battle damage created on purpose as well? Quite realistic.

spans.text: Were these marks of battle damage created on purpose as well? Quite realistic.

units.rawText: We often have these types of props on the set as well, they really immerse you into the act!
units.displayText: We often have these types of props on the set as well, they really immerse you into the act!

spans.text: We often have these types of props on the set as well, they really immerse you into the act!

units.rawText: Usually, when these appear, the main characters have found some sort of clue and they are about to put on a show! Let's go!
units.displayText: Usually, when these appear, the main characters have found some sort of clue and they are about to put on a show! Let's go!

spans.text: Usually, when these appear, the main characters have found some sort of clue and they are about to put on a show! Let's go!

units.rawText: Waving a fist, Jiangyu rushes in the direction in which the sign pointed, with Aki in tow. Not long after, a wall appears in front of the pair.
units.displayText: Waving a fist, Jiangyu rushes in the direction in which the sign pointed, with Aki in tow. Not long after, a wall appears in front of the pair.

spans.text: Waving a fist, Jiangyu rushes in the direction in which the sign pointed, with Aki in tow. Not long after, a wall appears in front of the pair.

units.rawText: We're at the end already?
units.displayText: We're at the end already?

spans.text: We're at the end already?

units.rawText: There's a person there. Hey, are you wor...
units.displayText: There's a person there. Hey, are you wor...

spans.text: There's a person there. Hey, are you wor...

units.rawText: Shh. Something's wrong.
units.displayText: Shh. Something's wrong.

spans.text: Shh. Something's wrong.

units.rawText: Aki gestures silence, shielding Jiangyu as his training as a bodyguard would have him do.
units.displayText: Aki gestures silence, shielding Jiangyu as his training as a bodyguard would have him do.

spans.text: Aki gestures silence, shielding Jiangyu as his training as a bodyguard would have him do.

units.rawText: The figure has its back turned towards the two, their features indistinct. They are putting up a rock sign in their left hand, and their right hand points upwards in front of their chest.
units.displayText: The figure has its back turned towards the two, their features indistinct. They are putting up a rock sign in their left hand, and their right hand points upwards in front of their chest.

spans.text: The figure has its back turned towards the two, their features indistinct. They are putting up a rock sign in their left hand, and their right hand points upwards in front of their chest.

units.rawText: What a strange, yet also familiar pose...
units.displayText: What a strange, yet also familiar pose...

spans.text: What a strange, yet also familiar pose...

units.rawText: Not only that. She's not responding to us, and the way she conducts herself is unnatural.
units.displayText: Not only that. She's not responding to us, and the way she conducts herself is unnatural.

spans.text: Not only that. She's not responding to us, and the way she conducts herself is unnatural.

units.rawText: But we're inside the Oasis, and there's no alarm or anything, so shouldn't it be safe?
units.displayText: But we're inside the Oasis, and there's no alarm or anything, so shouldn't it be safe?

spans.text: But we're inside the Oasis, and there's no alarm or anything, so shouldn't it be safe?

units.rawText: As she finishes her sentence, the area is bathed in a red light, and blaring alarms made their presence known.
units.displayText: As she finishes her sentence, the area is bathed in a red light, and blaring alarms made their presence known.

spans.text: As she finishes her sentence, the area is bathed in a red light, and blaring alarms made their presence known.

units.rawText: BEEP—Alert: Festival grounds entering lockdown mode! Festival grounds entering lockdown mode!
units.displayText: BEEP—Alert: Festival grounds entering lockdown mode! Festival grounds entering lockdown mode!

spans.text: BEEP—Alert: Festival grounds entering lockdown mode! Festival grounds entering lockdown mode!

units.rawText: Ehhhhh? I-is there really something going on...?
units.displayText: Ehhhhh? I-is there really something going on...?

spans.text: Ehhhhh? I-is there really something going on...?

units.rawText: Did this person sound the alarm? I never noticed a single movement of hers...
units.displayText: Did this person sound the alarm? I never noticed a single movement of hers...

spans.text: Did this person sound the alarm? I never noticed a single movement of hers...

units.rawText: To remain so unflinching in these circumstances, and to be so still in presence... could she be a true master?
units.displayText: To remain so unflinching in these circumstances, and to be so still in presence... could she be a true master?

spans.text: To remain so unflinching in these circumstances, and to be so still in presence... could she be a true master?

units.rawText: The pair cautiously approaches the figure, the latter still unmoving.
units.displayText: The pair cautiously approaches the figure, the latter still unmoving.

spans.text: The pair cautiously approaches the figure, the latter still unmoving.

units.rawText: Tch... just who are you?
units.displayText: Tch... just who are you?

spans.text: Tch... just who are you?

units.rawText: The figure remained still as stone.
units.displayText: The figure remained still as stone.

spans.text: The figure remained still as stone.

units.rawText: W-was it you that made the post?
units.displayText: W-was it you that made the post?

spans.text: W-was it you that made the post?

units.rawText: Stop it with the tricks! What do you want?
units.displayText: Stop it with the tricks! What do you want?

spans.text: Stop it with the tricks! What do you want?

units.rawText: Jiangyu advances, grabbing the figure's shoulder, intending to take a good look at her face. Her target instead collapsed onto her, leaning in with all of their weight—
units.displayText: Jiangyu advances, grabbing the figure's shoulder, intending to take a good look at her face. Her target instead collapsed onto her, leaning in with all of their weight—

spans.text: Jiangyu advances, grabbing the figure's shoulder, intending to take a good look at her face. Her target instead collapsed onto her, leaning in with all of their weight—

units.rawText: Uwah! W-what are you doing? Is this insurance fraud?
units.displayText: Uwah! W-what are you doing? Is this insurance fraud?

spans.text: Uwah! W-what are you doing? Is this insurance fraud?

units.rawText: Wait, Jiangyu, she...
units.displayText: Wait, Jiangyu, she...

spans.text: Wait, Jiangyu, she...

units.rawText: I think she's asleep.
units.displayText: I think she's asleep.

spans.text: I think she's asleep.

units.rawText: Wha, asleep?
units.displayText: Wha, asleep?

spans.text: Wha, asleep?

units.rawText: Jiangyu looked down at the girl in her lap. Her breathing was steady, and her face was peaceful, as if she was in a lovely dream.
units.displayText: Jiangyu looked down at the girl in her lap. Her breathing was steady, and her face was peaceful, as if she was in a lovely dream.

spans.text: Jiangyu looked down at the girl in her lap. Her breathing was steady, and her face was peaceful, as if she was in a lovely dream.

units.rawText: What the hell—why is someone sleeping here? Who is she anyway?
units.displayText: What the hell—why is someone sleeping here? Who is she anyway?

spans.text: What the hell—why is someone sleeping here? Who is she anyway?

units.rawText: By her attire, perhaps—
units.displayText: By her attire, perhaps—

spans.text: By her attire, perhaps—

units.rawText: What are you doing to Horizon?!
units.displayText: What are you doing to Horizon?!

spans.text: What are you doing to Horizon?!

units.rawText: A voice rings out behind them, its owner barely able to conceal their fury. The pair turn around to see Croque and Sakuya, their killing intent almost solidifying in the air.
units.displayText: A voice rings out behind them, its owner barely able to conceal their fury. The pair turn around to see Croque and Sakuya, their killing intent almost solidifying in the air.

spans.text: A voice rings out behind them, its owner barely able to conceal their fury. The pair turn around to see Croque and Sakuya, their killing intent almost solidifying in the air.

units.rawText: Breaking and entering the grounds, damaging doors and signs, assaulting staff, and now you mean to harm Horizon as well...
units.displayText: Breaking and entering the grounds, damaging doors and signs, assaulting staff, and now you mean to harm Horizon as well...

spans.text: Breaking and entering the grounds, damaging doors and signs, assaulting staff, and now you mean to harm Horizon as well...

units.rawText: Repent for your sins!
units.displayText: Repent for your sins!

spans.text: Repent for your sins!

units.rawText: Croque, Sakuya, and Horizon. Those were the three responsible for this venue, yes?
units.displayText: Croque, Sakuya, and Horizon. Those were the three responsible for this venue, yes?

spans.text: Croque, Sakuya, and Horizon. Those were the three responsible for this venue, yes?
